children: Coti Foundation has announced it will publish a detailed expansion to COTI's roadmap, with an emphasis on expanded COTI token spending ability. The update is scheduled to appear by 04 Oct 2026 and falls under the project's team update communications.

The stated focus on token spending ability points to changes in how COTI can be used within the project's payments infrastructure, rather than a general progress recap. Observers can evaluate the publication against that specific test: whether it names concrete utility changes, where those changes apply, and when they take effect.

Because the announcement is a commitment to publish rather than a shipped feature, the roadmap text itself carries the substance. Readers should treat the document as the basis for judging whether the payments thesis around COTI changes in practice, and note that delivery timelines described in roadmaps can shift.
COTI is excited to announce its new chapter.

title: COTI: Foundation to Publish Roadmap Expansion Focused on Token Spending Ability - By 04 Oct 2026
